jobs.title: Associate Frontend Engineer (React)
jobs.description: We are seeking an enthusiastic Associate Frontend Engineer to build high-performance, accessible web applications for our enterprise SaaS ecosystem. You will collaborate with product designers, backend engineers, and QA specialists to deliver smooth, polished user experiences.
requirements: Hands-on experience building web apps with React, JavaScript (ES6+), and modern CSS frameworks
Solid grasp of component lifecycle, hooks, and client-side performance optimization
Familiarity with REST APIs, Git version control, and responsive design principles

jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Developer (Python & React)
jobs.description: InnovateAI is looking for a versatile Full Stack Developer to build customer-facing analytics dashboards and backend data pipeline integrations. You will work across the full stack from database modeling to UI implementation.
requirements: Proficiency with Python (FastAPI or Django) and modern React
Experience querying and designing relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL)
Understanding of Docker containers and RESTful API best practices
Prior portfolio projects demonstrating end-to-end development

jobs.title: Cloud & DevOps Engineering Intern
jobs.description: Join our Cloud Platform team for a 6-month intensive internship focused on automating cloud deployments, continuous integration, and infrastructure monitoring.
requirements: Strong grasp of Linux command line, networking fundamentals, and Git
Hands-on projects with Docker and containerization
Basic familiarity with AWS services (EC2, S3, IAM)
Pre-placement offer (PPO) opportunities based on internship performance

jobs.title: Data Analyst Trainee
jobs.description: Transform complex business data into actionable executive insights. You will write SQL queries, automate reports, and build interactive dashboards.
requirements: Proficiency in complex SQL queries (Joins, Window functions, Aggregations)
Experience with Python for data manipulation (Pandas, NumPy)
Knowledge of dashboard tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, or Metabase
Strong communication skills for presenting findings
